import re

START = re.compile(r'^section_start:(?P<ts>\d+):(?P<name>[^\[\s\x1b]+)(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\r?\x1b?\[0K(?P<title>.*?)\s*$')
END = re.compile(r'^section_end:(?P<ts>\d+):(?P<name>[^\[\s\x1b]+)\r?\x1b?\[0K\s*$')
RUN = re.compile(r'^Running with gitlab-runner (?P<version>\S+)(?: \((?P<revision>[^)]+)\))?\s*$')
ON = re.compile(r'^\s+on (?P<runner>\S+)(?: (?P<token>[^\s,]+))?(?:, system ID: (?P<sysid>\S+))?\s*$')
RES = re.compile(r'^(?P<status>ERROR: Job failed|Job succeeded|WARNING: Job failed)(?::\s*(?P<reason>.*?))?\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    runner = {}
    runner_lines = []
    result = {}
    result_lines = []
    sections = []
    sec_lines = []
    log = []
    log_lines = []
    open_secs = {}
    stack = []
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines):
        line = raw.rstrip()
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = RUN.match(line)
        if m:
            runner['gitlab-runner version'] = m.group('version')
            if m.group('revision'):
                runner['revision'] = m.group('revision')
            runner_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = ON.match(line)
        if m and not stack:
            runner['runner'] = m.group('runner')
            if m.group('token'):
                runner['token'] = m.group('token')
            if m.group('sysid'):
                runner['system ID'] = m.group('sysid')
            runner_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = START.match(line)
        if m:
            rec = {'section': m.group('name'), 'start': int(m.group('ts')), 'end': '', 'duration_s': '', 'title': m.group('title')}
            sections.append(rec)
            open_secs[m.group('name')] = rec
            stack.append(m.group('name'))
            sec_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = END.match(line)
        if m:
            rec = open_secs.pop(m.group('name'), None)
            if rec is not None:
                rec['end'] = int(m.group('ts'))
                rec['duration_s'] = rec['end'] - rec['start']
            if m.group('name') in stack:
                stack.remove(m.group('name'))
            sec_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = RES.match(line)
        if m:
            result['status'] = m.group('status')
            reason = m.group('reason') or ''
            result['reason'] = reason
            em = re.search(r'exit code (\d+)', reason)
            if em:
                result['exit code'] = int(em.group(1))
            result_lines.append(i)
            continue
        kind = 'command' if line.startswith('$ ') else 'output'
        text = line[2:] if kind == 'command' else line
        log.append({'line': i, 'section': stack[-1] if stack else '', 'kind': kind, 'text': text})
        log_lines.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if runner:
        blocks.append({'name': 'runner', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': runner_lines, 'records': [runner]})
    if sections:
        blocks.append({'name': 'sections', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': sec_lines, 'records': sections})
    if log:
        blocks.append({'name': 'log', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': log_lines, 'records': log})
    if result:
        blocks.append({'name': 'result', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': result_lines, 'records': [result]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': []}
